summary.goal: Enable spawning planning agents via relay-pty when a plan is created or needs AI assistance
summary.context: Planning agents are Claude instances running in pseudo-terminals, spawned via relay-pty. They receive a system prompt instructing them to use MCP tools to build plans. The agent works continuously on draft plans until the human approves.

acceptance_criteria.description: Planning agent spawns when plan created with AI assistance requested
Agent receives system prompt with planning instructions
Agent receives context: goal, attachments, constraints
Agent appears in relay-dashboard for observability
Agent can be explicitly terminated
Mock agent behavior when relay unavailable

steps.title: Define planning agent system prompt
steps.description: Create src/relay/prompts/planning-agent.ts with the system prompt that instructs Claude how to behave as a planning agent. Include: MCP tool usage patterns, plan structure expectations, collaboration with human editors.

acceptance_criteria.description: System prompt defines planning agent role
Prompt includes MCP tool usage instructions
Prompt describes collaboration with humans
Prompt instructs periodic plan analysis for improvements (used by relay-ai-improvements)

steps.title: Create agent spawner module
steps.description: Create src/relay/spawner.ts that uses relay-pty to spawn Claude instances. Function: spawnPlanningAgent(planId, goal, context) returns { agentId, sessionToken }.

acceptance_criteria.description: Spawner creates Claude process via relay-pty
Agent registered with relay-daemon
Returns { agentId: string, sessionToken: string }
Agent receives plan_id and goal in initial context

steps.title: Configure agent MCP connection
steps.description: Pass MCP server connection details to spawned agent. Agent should connect back to Planner's MCP HTTP endpoints (from relay-mcp-bridge) to use planning tools.

acceptance_criteria.description: Agent receives MCP server URL in environment (MCP_SERVER_URL)
Agent receives session token for authentication (MCP_SESSION_TOKEN)
Agent can list and call MCP tools via HTTP

steps.note: Depends on relay-mcp-bridge providing HTTP transport - coordinate implementation order

steps.title: Create mock spawner for fallback
steps.description: Create src/relay/mock-spawner.ts that provides mock agent behavior when relay unavailable. Returns mock responses with realistic delays for testing UI without relay.

acceptance_criteria.description: Mock spawner matches spawner interface
Returns mock agentId and sessionToken
Mock agent provides canned responses
Configurable response delay for realistic UX

steps.title: Integrate spawn into plan creation
steps.description: Modify POST /plans handler: if relay available and AI assistance requested, spawn planning agent after creating plan record. If relay unavailable, use mock spawner.

acceptance_criteria.description: Agent spawned on plan creation when ai_assist=true
Plan record includes agent_id and session_id references
Falls back to mock spawner when relay unavailable
Spawn errors logged but don't fail plan creation

steps.title: Add agent termination
steps.description: Create terminateAgent(agentId) function. Call when plan is approved or explicitly requested. Also used by session timeout (relay-session-management).

acceptance_criteria.description: Agent process terminated cleanly
Relay-daemon notified of termination
Termination is idempotent (no error if already terminated)

steps.title: Add unit tests for spawner
steps.description: Create tests for spawner module: successful spawn, spawn failure handling, termination, mock fallback behavior.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests for successful agent spawn with mocked relay-pty
Tests for spawn failure graceful handling
Tests for agent termination
Tests for mock spawner fallback

System prompt includes MCP tool usage patterns
System prompt includes human collaboration instructions
System prompt includes improvement analysis instructions

Agent receives MCP_SERVER_URL and MCP_SESSION_TOKEN in environment
Mock spawner returns mock agentId and sessionToken
Mock spawner provides canned responses with configurable delay

Plan record includes agent_id and session_id after spawn

terminateAgent notifies relay-daemon of termination

data_requirements: Mocked relay-pty module for spawn tests
Test plan records with valid plan_id, goal, and context
Mocked relay-daemon for agent registration verification
Configurable mock response delays (0ms for unit tests, 100-500ms for UX tests)
